Copilot canvases.role: Shared, agent-built artifacts (wireframes, prototypes, docs) that humans and agents shape together.

Prompt files.role: Reusable prompt templates that capture how the team asks agents for recurring work.

Custom agents.role: Specialised agent personas (planner, designer, reviewer) defined in the repo.

Figma MCP.role: Brings Figma designs and wireframes into agent context through MCP.

Microsoft Teams.role: Start and steer agent work from chat; approvals and mentions where people already work.

Slack.role: Start and steer Copilot cloud agent sessions from Slack conversations.

GitHub Mobile.role: Capture ideas, steer sessions and approve work from the phone.

Issues + PRs.role: Issues carry intent to agents; pull requests return their work for human review.

GitHub Projects.role: Plan and track human and agent work on shared boards and roadmaps.

Attestations.role: Signed provenance that links every artifact to the build that produced it.

Azure Boards.role: Azure DevOps work tracking, linked to GitHub so agents pick up work items.

Jira.role: Meet teams where they are; Jira work items can be assigned to Copilot cloud agent.

Linear.role: Meet teams where they are; Linear issues can be assigned to Copilot cloud agent.

Copilot app.role: The desktop home for steering parallel agent sessions, from idea to merge.

Mission control.role: One place to start, monitor and steer agent sessions across repositories.

VS Code.role: The IDE where developers pair with agents and review their sessions.

Visual Studio.role: Copilot agent mode for .NET and C++ teams in Visual Studio.

Copilot CLI.role: Run, resume and steer agent sessions from the terminal.

JetBrains.role: Meet developers in JetBrains IDEs with Copilot agent mode.

Xcode.role: Meet Apple-platform developers in Xcode with Copilot.

Telemetry analysis.role: Analyse telemetry in the Copilot app and turn signals into new work for agents.

Azure Monitor.role: Metrics, logs and alerts for the software the factory ships.

Foundry tracing.role: Traces of agent runs, tool calls and model usage for review.

OpenTelemetry.role: Open standard for traces and metrics from agents and apps, any backend.

Datadog.role: Datadog monitoring feeds the Observe stage and reaches agents as tool context through MCP.

Copilot metrics.role: Adoption and usage metrics to measure the factory's throughput.

Audit log.role: Who (human or agent) did what, when; the audit trail for the factory.

Rulesets.role: Policy as code for branches and merges; agents can't bypass required checks.

Budgets.role: Spending limits and alerts for AI credits and compute.

Agent 365.role: Registry, access control and oversight for every agent in the enterprise.

Azure Policy.role: Enforce guardrails on the cloud resources agents provision and run on.

Cost Management.role: Track and optimise the cloud cost of the factory and what it runs.

Copilot Fusion.role: Orchestrates several models per task so each step gets a suitable model at the right cost.

Foundry Models.role: Enterprise catalog of cloud models, deployed in the customer's Azure tenant.

Model router.role: Routes each prompt to the most suitable Foundry model for quality and cost.

AI Gateway.role: AI Gateway in Azure API Management: one control point for models, MCP tools and agents (A2A), with access, quotas, token limits and logging.

Foundry Local.role: Run models on device for offline, private or low-cost agent steps.

AI credits.role: The unit for token usage; pay for the AI the factory actually consumes.

BYOK.role: Bring your own model keys and providers into Copilot.

Copilot cloud agent.role: Works on issues in a cloud sandbox and opens pull requests; many sessions in parallel.

Copilot CLI + SDK.role: Embed the Copilot agent runtime in your own tools, services and multi-agent systems.

Session continuity.role: One cloud session, resumable across the Copilot app, VS Code, CLI, web and phone.

Agent Framework.role: Open-source SDK for building custom agents and multi-agent workflows.

Foundry Agent Service.role: Host and scale business agents in Azure with identity, tools and tracing.

Claude.role: Third-party coding agents such as Claude run under the same GitHub governance via Agent HQ.

Codex.role: Third-party coding agents such as Codex run under the same GitHub governance via Agent HQ.

Hosted runners.role: Managed compute where plan, build and verify jobs run.

ARC runners.role: Self-hosted, autoscaling runners on your own Kubernetes for private networks.

Codespaces.role: Ready-to-code cloud dev environments, defined once and reused by people and agents.

Dev Box.role: Managed, secure developer workstations in Azure for regulated teams.

ACA sandboxes.role: Isolated, short-lived sandboxes (Container Apps dynamic sessions) to run agent-generated code safely.

AKS.role: Managed Kubernetes where shipped services run and are observed.

Container Apps.role: Serverless containers for apps, APIs and agents.

App Service.role: Managed hosting for web apps and APIs.

Azure SQL.role: Managed relational databases behind the software the factory ships.

Cosmos DB.role: Globally distributed NoSQL and vector database for apps and agents.

API Management.role: Govern and secure APIs, including AI and MCP gateways.

Azure Arc.role: One control plane for hybrid and multicloud environments.

AWS.role: The factory deploys to and observes workloads on AWS.

GCP.role: The factory deploys to and observes workloads on Google Cloud.

on-prem.role: On-premises and edge environments, managed with Azure Local and Arc.

Agentic workflows.role: Markdown-defined agent workflows on GitHub Actions, sandboxed with safe outputs.

GitHub Actions.role: Event-driven CI/CD and the engine for agent workflows.

Azure Pipelines.role: Azure DevOps CI/CD for existing pipelines.

Logic Apps.role: Low-code business workflows that trigger and consume agent work.

Jenkins.role: Existing Jenkins pipelines keep running alongside the factory.

Advanced Security.role: Code scanning, secret protection and supply-chain security for human and agent code.

Agent firewall.role: Controls the network egress of agent sandboxes with an allowlist.

Purview.role: Data security and compliance for the data agents read and produce.

Snyk.role: Snyk scans plug into the same verify gates.

Code review.role: Copilot reviews every pull request so humans review the evidence, not every line.

npm.role: The JavaScript package registry, operated by GitHub.

Work IQ.role: Workplace knowledge (meetings, mail, documents) for agents, from Microsoft 365.
